newsitem.title: USA: Southern Co ups qtly dividend to $0.325.
newsitem.headline: Southern Co ups qtly dividend to $0.325.

text.p: Southern Co said on Monday it raised the quarterly dividend on the company's common stock one penny to $0.325 a share.
The company said the dividend is payable March 6 to shareholders of record February 3.
The dividend increase is the company's sixth in as many years.
The new quarterly dividend equals an annual rate of $1.30 per share, the company said.
The company said the dividend increase reflects its strong performance in 1996 and optimism that the company is well-positioned for an era of increasing competition.
